name: Dain Ashward
summary: A crown soldier who mistakes obedience for keeping people safe.
act: He helped escort forced labor convoys and cannot undo that by discovering he was also used
arc: Choose obligations openly; share his body with Ilyr by agreement rather than domination
visual: Broad shoulders, crimson scales, charcoal segmented armor, one unpainted gauntlet; no resemblance to an existing game hero
voice: Short concrete sentences; notices doors, loads and exits before feelings

name: Tessa Vale
summary: A brilliant fugitive who treats every warning as an attempt to control her.
act: Her demonstration overloaded a public relay; admitting it does not validate the regime that exploited her
arc: Use restraint as an active skill, not surrender; teach safe magic without making herself indispensable
visual: Short dark hair, amber spectacles pushed onto forehead, cobalt coat, red mitten on casting hand
voice: Fast analogies, then sudden blunt honesty when frightened

name: Corren Hale
summary: A celebrated aerial guard trained to make dying look noble.
act: He cut a rescue cable on command and has accepted praise for the wrong reason
arc: Return, testify, and build rescue procedures that do not need martyrs
visual: Long ochre scarf with weighted ends, narrow teal breastplate, weathered flight harness
voice: Formal in public; dry, practical humor with the crew

name: Ivo Quill
summary: A maintenance engineer who believes a functioning machine justifies its compromises.
act: He designed the pressure regulator that made heartglass extraction scalable
arc: Build distributed power that can be maintained by ordinary crews; publish what he knows
visual: Gray curls, rolled sleeves, copper tool rig, ink-dark apron; stocky silhouette
voice: Explains emotions through repair problems until challenged to name them directly

name: Nera Fen
summary: A displaced guide who trusts routes more than institutions.
act: She once traded another settlement’s safe path for supplies for her own people
arc: Share knowledge without becoming everyone’s sole gatekeeper
visual: Moss-green cape split at the shoulders, long braid, cream fletching, worn map tube
voice: Precise about places; refuses vague claims about what everyone needs

name: Sister Oriel
summary: A healer whose institution confused probabilistic visions with divine authority.
act: She signed a prognosis that made a living dragonborn legally disposable
arc: Offer information without deciding another person’s life for them
visual: Ivory traveling stole, plum dress, brass bell without a clapper, close-cropped silver hair
voice: Patient, never omniscient; says what she does not know

name: Sable Renn
summary: A former binding officer who wants one heroic act to cancel her record.
act: She personally authored the seals used on dragonborn prisoners
arc: Help dismantle her work and accept testimony, restitution, and consequences
visual: Black-violet coat, exposed scarred forearm, straight white blade with broken runes
voice: Controlled legal language that gradually becomes personal and specific

name: Pip Marr
summary: A forger who saves people by making the authorities believe they are dead.
act: His forged registers also erased people’s legal claims to homes and wages
arc: Return names and agency instead of keeping everyone dependent on his tricks
visual: Rust waistcoat, green sash, cropped brown curls, satchel larger than his weapon
voice: Makes jokes to redirect attention; never jokes over a victim’s account
